contracts.description: Distance file gardiens : Papeete 16 000 km ne doit pas annuler la publication

checks.name: distance_km_precision
checks.sql: SELECT (numeric_precision = 8 AND numeric_scale = 2) AS ok FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'sitter_digest_queue' AND column_name = 'distance_km'

checks.name: publication_trigger_present
checks.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.sits'::regclass AND tgname = 'trg_notify_sitters_on_new_sit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok
